title: Quickstart templates — KPI baseline & targets (Activation + onboarding funnel) — v0.6
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-20
Owner: Talia Benson (DX Program)
Reviewers: Wei Chen (Docs), Logan Wright (Telemetry), Nadia Rahman (Metering), Dev Patel (Support), Sean Gallagher (SRE)

Purpose
- Establish baseline onboarding performance for Redwood Hosted API + new Quickstart templates.
- Set measurable targets for launch + 30/60/90 days.
- Define instrumentation and exact metric definitions (so we don’t argue about numbers post-launch).

Notes / guardrails
- This sheet focuses on PLG/self-serve onboarding. Enterprise-assisted onboarding has separate CS metrics.
- Baselines are computed from cohorts 2025-08-01 → 2025-10-31 (pre-template), excluding internal dogfood orgs and known load-test orgs.
- Targets apply to cohorts starting 2026-02-15 (post-template launch), with dashboarding in Console + product analytics.
- All times are in minutes/hours from org creation unless noted.

TAB: Metric definitions (source of truth)
| Metric | Definition | Numerator | Denominator | Window | Exclusions | Data sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Activation (A1) | Org achieves first successful LLM response (HTTP 2xx) from any generation/chat endpoint | # orgs w/ first_2xx_inference_response | # new orgs created | 7 days | internal dogfood orgs; suspicious traffic; retries-only (no 2xx) | Hosted API logs; product analytics event: inference_response_2xx |
| Activation (A2 - “Template activation”) | Org achieves a successful run of any official quickstart template (local dev path) | # orgs w/ template_run_success | # new orgs created | 7 days | internal dogfood | template telemetry (quickstart.telemetry.contract.v1) + docs-site click-through + GitHub clone proxy logs (if available) |
| First-call success rate | First inference request returns 2xx without user-visible error | # orgs where first_request_outcome = success | # orgs with a first_request_sent | 24 hours | internal, load tests | Hosted API gateway logs; SDK helper emits request outcome |
| Time-to-first-success (TTFS) | Minutes from org_created_at to first 2xx inference response | p50 / p95 across activated orgs | N/A | 7 days | internal | Product analytics + gateway logs |
| Time-to-template-success (TTT) | Minutes from first template start (first template_run_started) to template_run_success | p50 / p95 across template starters | N/A | 24 hours | internal | template instrumentation |
| 429 rate during onboarding | Fraction of orgs that see at least one 429 during first 24h (any endpoint) | # orgs w/ any_429_first_24h | # orgs w/ any_request_first_24h | 24 hours | internal; known abusive | gateway logs; SDK error typing |
| Streaming stability | % of streaming sessions that complete without client disconnect (where server completed) | # streams_completed_cleanly | # streams_started | 24 hours | internal | SDK streaming callbacks + gateway close codes |
| Docs-to-run conversion | % of docs quickstart visitors who start a template within 1 hour | # users w/ template_run_started | # unique docs visitors on /quickstarts/* | 1 hour | internal IP ranges | docs analytics + template events |
| Observability “hooked up” rate | % of template runs that emit required telemetry fields (trace + logs + metrics) | # template_run_success with all required attrs present | # template_run_success | 7 days | internal | telemetry validations in templates + OTLP ingest |
| Support deflection proxy | # template-related support tickets per 1k new orgs | count(template_onboarding_tickets)/new_orgs*1000 | N/A | 30 days | N/A | Jira Support tagging + new_org count |

TAB: Baseline vs Targets (primary KPIs)
Cohort definition:
- Baseline cohort: org_created_at 2025-08-01 → 2025-10-31
- Target cohort: org_created_at >= 2026-02-15

| KPI | Baseline (pre-template) | Target @ launch+30d | Target @ launch+60d | Target @ launch+90d | Owner | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Activation A1 (7d) | 31% | 38% | 42% | 45% | DX (Alex / Talia) | Primary business KPI; assumes docs landing + templates reduce first-call failures.
| First-call success rate (24h) | 72% | 80% | 84% | 86% | SDK (Monica / Ibrahim) | Driven by timeout/retry defaults + clearer key/region errors.
| TTFS p50 (mins) | 26 | 15 | 12 | 10 | DX + Docs | Goal stated in project charter: <15 min to first successful run.
| TTFS p95 (mins) | 240 | 120 | 90 | 75 | DX + Support | Reduce tail: misconfig, 429 confusion, streaming disconnects.
| Template activation A2 (7d) | N/A (no official templates) | 18% | 22% | 25% | DX + Docs | We expect subset of orgs use templates vs direct API.
| TTT p50 (mins) | N/A | 8 | 7 | 6 | DX | Time from starting template to success.
| 429 incidence (orgs w/ any 429 in first 24h) | 14% | 12% | 10% | 9% | SRE + Product | Expect improvement from backoff guidance + SDK helper.
| Streaming stability (% clean completes) | 93.5% | 96% | 97% | 97.5% | SDK + SRE | Proxy disconnect issues were a top ticket driver; track by SDK version.
| Observability “hooked up” rate | ~0% (not standardized) | 70% | 80% | 90% | Platform/Tel (Logan) | Requires OTLP defaults in templates + easy “send to Console” flow.
| Template-related support tickets / 1k new orgs | 6.8 | 5.5 | 4.5 | 4.0 | Support (Dev Patel) | Requires consistent error taxonomy + docs improvements.

TAB: Funnel breakdown (baseline)
Baseline funnel, 7-day window (2025-08-01 → 2025-10-31):
| Step | Event / Criteria | Baseline conversion | Biggest drop reasons (qual) |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | Org created | 100% | N/A |
| 2 | API key created | 68% | Confusion about project/org setup; users exploring pricing first |
| 3 | First request sent | 49% | Missing SDK install; unclear endpoint/model; CORS issues |
| 4 | First response 2xx | 31% | 401/403 from bad keys; 404 from model/route mismatch; timeouts; 429; JSON parsing errors |
| 5 | Second successful call within 1h | 22% | Lack of next-step guidance; “what model should I pick” |

Baseline top first-request failure modes (first 24h):
| Error class | % of failed first requests | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Auth (401/403) | 33% | Wrong env var name; copied wrong key; whitespace/newline issues |
| Rate limit (429) | 18% | Burst from retries w/o backoff; free tier limits; confusion about headers |
| Timeout / network | 16% | Missing client timeout; proxy issues; long prompts |
| Bad request (400) | 14% | JSON/schema issues; tool calling format mistakes |
| Route/model mismatch (404) | 9% | Region/model availability mismatch; stale docs snippets |
| Other | 10% | Mixed |

TAB: Template-specific KPIs (post-launch)
These are the KPIs we will report weekly for the templates initiative.

| KPI | Definition | Target | Segment cuts | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Template starts | # of template_run_started | +30% WoW for first 4 weeks | language (py/ts), template type (rag/agents/combined) | Proxy for interest; should correlate with docs traffic.
| Template success rate | template_run_success / template_run_started | >= 70% @ 30d, >= 78% @ 90d | template type; OS (mac/linux/windows); sdk version | We expect early friction from local deps (vector DB, docker).
| Template TTFS | mins from template_run_started to first inference 2xx inside the template | p50 <= 10 mins | language/template | Must stay <15 min.
| “Deploy in 60” | % orgs that perform a deploy action within 60 mins of first template success | >= 10% @ 60d | docker/k8s | Deploy action = docker_compose_up_success OR k8s_apply_success OR cloud-run doc completion.
| Observability completeness | % template successes with required trace attrs + log fields + metric names | >= 80% @ 60d | language/template | Enforced by template validators + CI smoke tests.
| Console deep-link usage | % of template runs where user clicks Console trace/dashboard link | >= 15% @ 60d | docs vs repo README | Helps ensure telemetry leads to value (not just emitted).

TAB: Instrumentation plan (events + where emitted)
Principles
- Prefer server-side truth (gateway logs, request IDs) for “did it work” metrics.
- Prefer low-cardinality identifiers for telemetry (org_id, template_name, language, sdk_version, deployment_mode).
- Avoid PII. No raw prompts/doc text in analytics.

Required IDs to join datasets
- org_id (canonical)
- project_id (if applicable)
- request_id (from gateway; echoed back to client)
- trace_id / span_id (OTel)
- sdk_language + sdk_version
- template_name + template_version

Events to implement (post-launch)
| Event name | Emitter | Required fields | When | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| org_created | backend | org_id, created_at, plan_tier | on org create | cohort + denominator |
| api_key_created | backend | org_id, key_type | on key create | funnel step |
| first_request_sent | SDK helper | org_id, sdk_version, route, model, streaming | first request attempt | funnel + error analysis |
| inference_response | gateway | org_id, request_id, status_code, error_class, latency_ms, token_usage_total, token_usage_input, token_usage_output, model, route | each response | activation + cost/lat |
| template_run_started | template app | org_id, template_name, template_version, language, env (local/docker/k8s) | process start | template starts |
| template_run_success | template app | above + duration_ms + obs_present (bool) | on successful end-to-end run | template success |
| template_run_failed | template app | error_class, failure_stage (config/ingest/query/tool/otel) | on failure | improve docs + reduce tickets |
| dashboard_import_attempted | template/CLI | org_id, pack_version, outcome | when importing obs pack | obs adoption |
| docs_quickstart_view | docs site | anon_user_id, page, referrer | page view | docs-to-run conversion |
| docs_copy_api_key_snippet | docs site | page, snippet_id | copy event | intent signal |

Error taxonomy (must align across SDK/templates/support)
- auth_error
- rate_limited
- timeout
- network_error
- invalid_request
- model_not_found
- tool_error
- vector_store_error
- otel_export_error
- unknown

Mapping notes:
- gateway provides status_code + request_id. SDK helper should map to error_class for client-side errors (timeout, network) that do not produce a gateway response.
- template error stages must be consistent across languages (py/ts). Suggested stages: config, ingest, retrieval, generation, tool, streaming, telemetry.

TAB: Data sources & queries (implementation notes)
- Hosted API gateway logs: authoritative for request outcomes, status codes, latency, request_id, model, route.
- Metering service (Nadia): token usage breakdown (input/output) for cost panels.
- OTel ingest (Caleb/Logan): trace_id correlation + metrics. Validate required attributes per telemetry contract v1.
- Docs analytics (Wei/Elliot): docs views, click-through, snippet copy.
- Support Jira (Dev/Owen): ticket volume tagged “quickstarts/templates”; need consistent labels.

Planned dashboards (weekly review)
- “Onboarding funnel” (org created → key → first req → 2xx)
- “Template success & TTFS” (by language/template type)
- “Top onboarding errors” (error_class + failure_stage)
- “429 & retry behavior” (429 incidence, backoff compliance where detectable)
- “Streaming health” (disconnect rate, by SDK version)

TAB: Risks / open questions
1) Joining docs analytics (anon) to org_id is non-trivial.
   - Proposed: attribute via optional “redwood_org_id” in docs query param after login, plus non-PII cookie.
2) Template start event reliability.
   - If user runs template offline without telemetry export, we lose signal; we should still count based on docs click + GitHub clone where possible.
3) Defining “deploy in 60” without overcounting.
   - Need clear server-side confirmation: healthcheck ping from deployed env OR explicit CLI action with success.
4) Internal dogfood contamination.
   - Must maintain allowlist/denylist of orgs in the metric pipeline.

TAB: Change log
- 2026-02-20: Updated targets post-launch; added Console deep-link usage KPI; refined first-call success definition to exclude silent retries without a 2xx.
- 2026-02-07: Added streaming stability KPI + error taxonomy draft.
- 2025-12-12: First draft baseline funnel based on 2025-08 → 2025-10 cohorts.

Action items
- Logan: confirm required trace attrs/metric names for “observability completeness” scoring (align to telemetry contract v1). Due 2026-02-26.
- Monica/Ibrahim: ensure SDK helper emits first_request_sent + maps client-side timeouts to error_class=timeout. Due 2026-03-01.
- Wei/Elliot: add docs events (view + snippet copy) and propose login-based org attribution approach. Due 2026-03-05.
- Dev: define Jira tagging rule + baseline extraction query for template-related tickets. Due 2026-03-05.
